The present invention relates to the field of disposable absorbent articles, specifically an infant diaper assembly designated for wearers within a weight range of approximately 16 to 28 pounds. The absorbent article comprises a chassis including a topsheet, a backsheet, and an absorbent core disposed therebetween, wherein the absorbent core comprises three distinct absorbency layers configured to sequentially acquire, distribute, and retain bodily fluids. A moisture-wicking liner, referred to as the Absorb Away liner, is positioned adjacent to the topsheet and configured to transport liquid away from the wearer's skin surface. The article further comprises a wetness indicator embedded within the backsheet, wherein said indicator undergoes a visible chromatic change upon exposure to a predetermined moisture threshold. In certain embodiments directed to newborn sizes, the article includes an umbilical cord notch formed in the anterior waistband region. The product is packaged in a quantity of 168 units per commercial package.

The present disclosure relates to the field of disposable absorbent articles, and more particularly to an infant diaper assembly configured for subjects within a weight range of approximately 16 to 28 pounds. In one embodiment, the absorbent article comprises a three-layer absorbent core, wherein each layer is configured to sequentially acquire, distribute, and retain aqueous body fluids. A moisture-wicking topsheet, herein referred to as an Absorb Away liner, is disposed adjacent to the wearer-facing surface and is configured to transport liquid away from the skin by capillary action. The article further comprises a colorimetric wetness indicator integrated into a backsheet layer, wherein said indicator undergoes a visible chromatic transition upon exposure to a predetermined fluid volume. In certain embodiments directed to newborn sizing, the article comprises an umbilical cord notch formed in the anterior waistband region. The product is commercially distributed in packages comprising 168 individual units.

Pampers Swaddlers Size 3 is a disposable absorbent hygiene product indicated for use on infants and toddlers within a weight range of 16 to 28 pounds (approximately 7.3 to 12.7 kg). Each unit comprises a three-layer absorbent core designed to acquire, distribute, and retain liquid. The product incorporates a proprietary Absorb Away liner positioned at the body-facing surface to facilitate rapid moisture transfer away from the skin. A wetness indicator, integrated into the exterior shell, provides a visual color-change signal upon exposure to moisture, indicating saturation status. An umbilical cord notch is present on newborn sizes to accommodate the healing navel area. Packaging configuration: 168 units per package. Store in a cool, dry environment. Not intended for use as a medical device.

The present invention relates to the field of infant nutritional compositions. Disclosed herein is an infant formula composition comprising milk fat globule membrane (MFGM) components and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), wherein said composition is configured to approximate the fat-protein globule structure of human breast milk. In a preferred embodiment, the composition provides approximately 17 mg of DHA per 100 kcal and approximately 1.8 mg of iron per 100 kcal, with a caloric density of about 20 calories per fluid ounce when reconstituted. The MFGM-enriched composition comprises a plurality of bioactive lipids and membrane-associated glycoproteins derived from bovine milk processing. The powdered formulation thereof is provided in a container having a net weight of approximately 20.7 oz. The method of claim 1, wherein the MFGM component substantially replicates the globule membrane architecture of native human milk fat, thereby supporting neurological development in the infant.

The composition further comprises iron at approximately 1.8 mg per 100 kcal. A distinguishing aspect of the present embodiment involves a fat-protein globule structure substantially analogous to that of human breast milk, thereby facilitating improved nutrient bioavailability. The composition is provided in a container having net contents of approximately 20.7 oz. The method of claim 1, wherein the MFGM-enriched formulation supports neurological development through synergistic interaction between membrane lipids and DHA thereof.

The present invention relates to a topical dermatological composition for pediatric skin care, comprising white petrolatum at a concentration of approximately 41% by weight as the primary occlusive barrier-forming agent. The composition is provided in a 3.0 oz dispensing tube and is formulated to be substantially free of fragrance compounds and preservative agents, thereby reducing the incidence of contact sensitization in infant populations. In a preferred embodiment, the composition is configured as a multi-purpose barrier ointment indicated for the treatment of diaper dermatitis and xerotic skin conditions. The formulation has been evaluated and recommended by pediatric healthcare practitioners. Wherein the petrolatum component forms a semi-occlusive film upon application to compromised epidermal surfaces, the composition provides moisture retention and mechanical protection against irritant exposure in neonatal and infant skin.

The present invention relates to the field of topical dermatological compositions for pediatric skin care. In a preferred embodiment, the composition comprises white petrolatum at a concentration of approximately 41% by weight, serving as a primary occlusive skin protectant agent. The composition is substantially free of fragrance compounds and preservative agents, thereby reducing the incidence of allergic contact dermatitis in neonatal and infant populations. The formulation is configured to function as a multi-purpose barrier ointment, wherein the composition is indicated for both the treatment of diaper dermatitis and the amelioration of xerotic skin conditions. The product is dispensed from a collapsible tube containing approximately 3.0 fluid ounces thereof. In certain embodiments, the formulation has received recommendation from board-certified pediatricians for prophylactic application as a barrier agent to the epidermal surface.

The active ingredient, white petrolatum USP, is present at a concentration of 41% w/w. The formulation is fragrance-free and preservative-free, minimizing the risk of sensitization in neonatal and infant skin. Directions for use: Apply liberally to affected area as needed. For external use only. Supplied in a 3.0 oz (85 g) tube. This product is classified as a multi-purpose barrier ointment and is recommended by pediatricians for prophylactic and therapeutic application to intact or mildly compromised skin surfaces. Discontinue use and consult a physician if condition worsens or persists beyond seven days.

The wipe substrate is configured with a triple-layered construction, wherein each layer is bonded to adjacent layers to provide enhanced soil removal capacity. The aqueous solution applied to said substrate comprises approximately 99% purified water by weight, the formulation being substantially free of fragrance compounds. In one embodiment, the product is packaged in a dispensing container holding 528 individual wipe units. The plant-based composition of the substrate provides biodegradability characteristics while maintaining tensile strength sufficient for effective cleansing. The method of manufacturing thereof comprises depositing the aqueous solution onto said nonwoven substrate under controlled conditions to achieve uniform saturation.

All of this in a lean 18 g scoop at just 10 calories per serving. No fillers. No compromise. Stop warming up to mediocrity — unleash every rep.

The present invention relates to the field of sports nutrition compositions, and more particularly to a pre-workout dietary supplement. In a preferred embodiment, the composition comprises, per serving unit of approximately 18 g: L-citrulline DL-malate in an amount of about 8,000 mg, configured to promote endogenous nitric oxide synthesis and vasodilation at a clinical dosage; beta-alanine in an amount of about 3,200 mg; and a sustained-release caffeine complex comprising caffeine derived from Camellia sinensis leaf extract and Paullinia cupana seed extract, wherein the total caffeine content is about 300 mg per serving unit. The composition provides approximately 10 kilocalories per serving. The sustained-release caffeine complex is configured to deliver a plurality of pharmacokinetic release phases, thereby substantially extending the ergogenic effect thereof relative to conventional anhydrous caffeine formulations.

The present invention relates to a pre-workout nutritional composition, designated NitroEdge Pre-Workout Surge, comprising, per unit serving of approximately 18 g: L-citrulline DL-malate in an amount of about 8 g, configured to promote endogenous nitric oxide production; a sustained-release caffeine complex comprising caffeine derived from green tea (Camellia sinensis) extract and guarana (Paullinia cupana) extract, wherein said caffeine complex provides approximately 300 mg of total caffeine per serving; and beta-alanine in an amount of approximately 3.2 g. The composition provides approximately 10 calories per serving. In a preferred embodiment, the sustained-release caffeine delivery system is configured to provide a substantially uniform plasma caffeine concentration over a period of between about 3 and about 6 hours, thereby reducing peak-to-trough variability relative to immediate-release caffeine formulations. The composition thereof may be reconstituted in an aqueous medium prior to oral administration.

NitroEdge Pre-Workout Surge is a powdered dietary supplement formulated for oral consumption prior to physical exercise. Each 18 g serving contains the following active ingredients: L-citrulline DL-malate (2:1), 8,000 mg, included at a clinical dose to support nitric oxide production and vasodilation; beta-alanine (3-aminopropionic acid), 3,200 mg; caffeine (anhydrous equivalent: 300 mg), derived from Camellia sinensis (green tea) leaf extract and Paullinia cupana (guarana) seed extract, providing sustained-release pharmacokinetics. Energy value per serving: 10 kcal (42 kJ). Directions for use: Mix one serving (18 g) with 240–360 mL of water and consume 20–30 minutes before exercise. Do not exceed one serving per day. Warning: Contains 300 mg caffeine per serving. Not recommended for individuals sensitive to stimulants, pregnant or nursing women, or persons under 18 years of age. Consult a healthcare professional before use.
